name: Bird Hunter
summary: Bird Hunter is a clone of the WarioWare minigame Pyoro, where the player controls a bird that moves left and right at the bottom of the screen. The objective is to shoot its tongue diagonally upward to catch fruit falling from the sky before it hits the ground. If a piece of fruit lands on the floor, it destroys that block of terrain; stepping into a hole or getting hit directly on the head by a fruit causes an instant game over.
